verdict: The materials are right and the onboarding proves the standard is real — beat 10 commits one 52pt idea to a page that is two-thirds empty, beat 13 lets one photograph and one didone numeral do everything. The app pages have not made that commitment: Home stacks three near-equal claims and lets a 64pt calorie figure out-shout its own 38pt headline, evening runs four ideas including outlined chips and a boxed input, and becoming's cover crowds five type registers into the top 40% and abandons the rest as leftover void. That is assembly, not composition. What already reaches the bar: the bubble-less chat typesetting, the 860 didone figure itself, the ledger row grammar, and becoming's headline block down to "talk it through" — the failures are of ownership and placement, not of vocabulary.

compositions.composition: THE FRONT PAGE. One headline owns it: the kept line at 52-56pt over two lines, top-left, its hairline running off the right edge of the page like a printed rule, a 64pt hollow sparkle seal hung in the right margin on the headline's baseline. Below the fold, one figure: 860 in 64-72pt didone with italic "calories" and a single 15pt caption line. The ledger (overnight fast / steps) drops to the FOOT — a two-row table sitting just above the bar, 13pt caps labels, 30pt serif values — so the page has head, figure, and foot like a broadsheet, and the emptiness lives in the middle where it reads as composed, not at the bottom where it reads as ran-out. Chrome: the date eyebrow and one bare glyph, nothing filled.

THE CLOSING RECEIPT. One headline: "closing the day." at 52pt. Beneath it the whole day as a signed receipt — three ledger rows (protein *62* of 90g / tomorrow a *balanced* day / evening · one plate still open), then "how did it feel" as three typeset italic words proud · okay · tender at 24pt, tap sets one rose, then a single baseline rule under a 13pt caps label BEST PLATE TODAY where her one line writes itself. No chips, no boxes, no second hero; the page ends at the rule, like a letter ends at the signature.

THE COVER. Masthead "becoming" stays small with the week eyebrow; the week's thesis moves to 56-64pt and sits at the optical center of the FULL page height — the beat-19 placement — with the 19pt body directly beneath and "talk it through" as the only link. The cycle note becomes a one-line 13pt caps footnote at the page foot. Type-only; imagery belongs to the spreads. Trailing-edge fore-edge slivers plus a folio ("1 / 12") in 11pt caps at the outer foot corner replace the dash pager.

Not captured — 04 and 05 are byte-identical to the cover, so the spreads are prescribed, not judged. EVERY SPREAD = ONE FIGURE + ONE LINE. Weight: the trend drawn as a single 2pt rose stroke running edge to edge off both margins, the current weight hung beneath the stroke's end as a 72pt didone numeral, one 15pt caption, nothing else. Pacing: the mounds figure takes the entire lower half at full width; a 44pt headline above; any third element is deleted. Once a week, one spread runs one of her real plate photographs full-bleed with a single 13pt caps caption — the photograph does all the emotional work, exactly as onboarding beat 13 already proves it can.

THE INTERVIEW. jeni's paragraphs stay 19pt cocoa flush left; the user's lines set 16-17pt italic serif flush right in rose — two voices, two registers, no bubbles. Day breaks become centered 11pt caps rules (MONDAY between hairlines) like section breaks in a long-form interview. The composer is a baseline rule with a small rose arrow set as type. The doubled exchange and the eyebrow ghost go before anything else does — typesetting errors are the one thing a magazine cannot survive.

checklist_iconic.diagnosis: The kept line is a 38pt sentence with a 20pt hollow asterisk right-aligned after it — it reads as a footnote reference, not a seal, and it is out-shouted by the 64pt calorie numeral below. A screenshot of this page shows no state, no ceremony, no proof that anything was kept; nobody screenshots a sentence. The signature interaction is currently invisible at rest and inaudible when it fires.
checklist_iconic.proposal: Make the kept line the day's front page and the seal its stamp. The line sets at 52-56pt over two lines, top-left; a 64pt hollow sparkle sits in the right margin ON the headline baseline, cut by the same hairline, which runs off the page edge. Kept = the stamp: the sparkle fills rose with a 1.4-to-1.0 spring and one soft haptic, the headline settles from cocoa to deep rose, and the sub-line reprints as a receipt — "kept at 7:42" in 13pt letterspaced caps. The page visibly changes edition, morning proof to evening proof, different every day, always in the same frame. That is the screenshot: an enormous serif line, a filled rose seal, a timestamp in small caps on cream — a stamped proof, not a checklist. Buildable entirely with the locked type, the sparkle mark, one spring, one haptic.

becoming_pageturn: Pages must land like paper, not slide like tabs. On each page give scrollTransition a 4-6 degree rotation about the leading edge with a 6% scale dip and opacity to 0.92 as it leaves; the incoming page carries an 8pt-wide 2% cocoa gradient on its leading edge — the shadow of a lifting sheet — that fades to nothing as it settles. Parallax the text block against the page edge by offsetting content -14pt times the transition phase, so the type prints into place a beat after the paper arrives. Snap with a weighted settle (spring response ~0.5, damping ~0.85, no rubber-band) — a page turn has mass. Replace the foot dashes with a folio numeral ("2 / 12", 11pt caps, outer foot corner, riding each page) and two or three fixed 1pt fore-edge slivers on the trailing margin, 3pt apart, hinting the unread pages like the fore-edge of a closed magazine. All of it is scrollTransition phases, one gradient, and type — nothing outside the locked kit.
one_move: Enforce one owner per page at the 52pt register, starting where it pays most: Home. Set the kept line at 56pt with the stampable rose seal, cut the calorie caption to one line, drop the ledger to the foot, and delete the filled camera disc — then apply the same law everywhere (evening loses its second hero, becoming's thesis takes the optical center). The app stops negotiating between three medium voices and starts speaking in one large one; that single commitment is the distance between engineered and designed.
